explanation: Son of King Solomon and successor as king over Israel. He increased taxes and forced labor, which led to a division in the kingdom.
A former officer under King Solomon who became leader of the ten northern tribes of Israel after the kingdom was divided.
A territory or society ruled by a monarch, in this case the kingdom of Israel.
The process by which a kingdom or society is split into smaller units due to disagreements or conflicts.
A person who claims to convey divine messages from God to people, often with the purpose of guiding or warning.
The prophet from Shiloh who predicted that Jeroboam would become king over ten tribes and that the kingdom would be divided.
Two idols that Jeroboam made and placed in the cities of Bethel and Dan to prevent the people from going to Jerusalem to worship.
An action or thought that goes against God's will and can lead to spiritual separation from God.
